title: 4 Small 'Pay in 4' Plans Became $840 a Month

scenes.say: $840 a month. That's what four small 'pay in 4' plans now take from Owen.
Sneakers, headphones, a jacket, and a couch. Each one felt tiny at checkout, so he never added them up.
That's $1,680 of stuff, split into four payments, every two weeks.
So every two weeks, about $420 leaves his account at once.
Each plan only said $60 or $90. Together, over a month, it's almost the size of a rent payment.
And if one payment bounces, late fees can land on top of everything else.
His new rules are simple, and they stop the stacking.

items.text: Only one plan at a time

scenes.say: How many plans are you paying right now? Subscribe so you don't make this mistake on your next paycheck.
